fields.name: Kopi C
fields.description: Our everyday kopi C, brewed the traditional Nanyang way in a cloth sock filter and finished with evaporated milk and a spoon of sugar: creamy, smooth and only mildly sweet. One 8 oz cup, served hot, or iced (kopi C peng) at the same price.
fields.information:
Our everyday kopi C, brewed the traditional Nanyang way. We roast a blend of Robusta and a little Liberica beans with butter and sugar, then brew it in a cloth sock filter (the "kopi sock") and pull it between two pots to cool it slightly and give it body. It's finished with evaporated milk and a spoon of sugar, so it's creamy, smooth and only mildly sweet.

Size: one 8 oz (240 ml) cup, served hot. Iced kopi C (kopi C peng) is available at the same price, served in a 16 oz cup with ice.

Sweetness: regular sugar by default. Ask for siew dai (less sweet), kosong (no sugar) or ga dai (extra sweet) at no extra cost.

Allergens and dietary notes: contains dairy (evaporated milk). The beans are roasted with butter, so even kopi O (without milk) isn't dairy-free. No nuts are used in the drink itself, but our kitchen handles peanuts. One cup has roughly the caffeine of a double espresso.

Best enjoyed straight away; we don't recommend keeping it for later.

FAQs about this drink:
- Can I have it with oat or soy milk? Not at the moment: we only stock evaporated and condensed milk.
- Can I order a flask for the office? Yes, a 1-litre flask (about 4 cups) is $7.00. Please order at least 2 hours ahead.
- Is it strong? Yes, it's stronger than a café latte, because of the Robusta beans.

fields.name: Kaya Toast Set
fields.description: Our classic breakfast set: two slices of charcoal-grilled toast with cold butter and house-made kaya, two soft-boiled eggs with light soy sauce and white pepper, and a hot kopi C or teh C. Available all day.
fields.information:
Our classic breakfast set, the way Singaporeans have started the day for generations.

What's in the set:
- Two slices of charcoal-grilled white bread, crisp on the outside, with a thick slab of cold salted butter and our house-made kaya.
- Two soft-boiled eggs (cooked for about 6 minutes, still runny), served with light soy sauce and white pepper on the side.
- One hot drink: kopi C or teh C (tea with evaporated milk). You can swap it for an iced drink for $0.50 more.

About our kaya: we cook it in small batches every morning from fresh coconut milk, eggs, sugar and pandan leaves, stirring it for about two hours until it's thick and caramel-brown. It has no preservatives, so it's best on the day.

Options: ask for wholemeal bread at no extra cost, or extra kaya for $0.80.

Allergens: contains wheat (gluten), eggs, dairy (butter, evaporated milk) and soy (soy sauce). The kaya contains coconut. Our kitchen also handles peanuts and sesame.

Takeaway: the eggs are packed separately so they don't overcook. Available all day.

FAQs about this set:
- Can I order the toast without the eggs? Yes, the toast and drink alone are $3.80; just tell us when ordering.
- Can the eggs be cooked harder? Yes, ask for well-done eggs (about 9 minutes).

fields.name: Seasonal Brunch Plate
fields.description: A rotating weekend special from our chef, served on Saturdays and Sundays from 9am to 2pm while stocks last. It's currently not on sale while we plan the next menu.
fields.information:
A rotating weekend special from our chef, served on Saturdays and Sundays from 9am to 2pm while stocks last. It's currently not on sale while we plan the next menu.

The last version was nasi lemak-inspired: coconut rice cooked with pandan, a crispy chicken thigh marinated in turmeric and lemongrass, a sunny-side-up egg, cucumber, roasted peanuts, ikan bilis (fried anchovies) and our house sambal, which is fairly spicy.

Allergens of the last version: peanuts, fish (anchovies, and shrimp paste in the sambal), egg and coconut.

fields.name: Classic Red Rose Bouquet (12 Stems)
fields.description: Twelve long-stemmed red roses, hand-tied with eucalyptus and baby's breath in our signature blush wrapping: the timeless way to say "I love you".
fields.information:
Collection: fresh flowers.

What's in it: 12 premium red roses (the Ecuadorian 'Explorer' variety, 50 to 60 cm stems, with heads about 6 cm across when fully open), seasonal silver dollar eucalyptus and baby's breath, hand-tied in a spiral and finished with a satin ribbon. The bouquet is about 55 cm tall and 35 cm wide, and is wrapped in water-resistant matte paper: blush pink by default, or black, white or kraft on request at no extra cost.

How long it lasts: our roses are flown in from Ecuador twice a week (Tuesdays and Fridays) and rested in our cold room before arranging. With proper care they last 5 to 7 days after delivery; the heads usually open fully on day 2 or 3. Every bouquet has an aqua pack (a sealed water pouch) at the base, which keeps the flowers hydrated for up to 24 hours, so they can stay in the wrapping on the day itself.

Care: remove the wrapping and aqua pack, trim 2 cm off each stem at an angle with a sharp knife, and place the roses in a clean vase with cool water and the flower food sachet provided. Change the water and re-trim the stems every 2 days. Keep the bouquet away from direct sunlight, aircon vents and ripening fruit, which releases a gas that makes roses age faster. A drooping head can often be revived by re-cutting the stem and leaving it in deep water for an hour.

Options:
- Colour: pink, white, peach or mixed roses at the same price.
- More roses: 24 stems for $178, or 99 stems for $588 (pre-order at least 5 days ahead).
- Add-ons: a box of 16 Ferrero Rocher chocolates for $22, or a 20 cm plush teddy bear for $18.
- A greeting card with your message is always included free.

Peak periods: during Valentine's week (7 to 14 February) this bouquet is $168, because import prices for roses more than double, and Valentine's orders must be placed by 7 February. Prices on Mother's Day weekend stay the same.

Allergies and pets: roses have very little pollen, but baby's breath can bother very sensitive people and is mildly toxic to cats and dogs; we can leave it out and add more eucalyptus instead.

Good to know: roses are a natural product, so each head varies slightly in shade and size. If the variety is unavailable on your date, we substitute with roses of the same colour and equal or higher value, and message you first.

fields.name: Everlasting Dried Flower Bouquet (Neutral Tones)
fields.description: A soft, rustic bouquet of pampas grass, bunny tails and golden billy buttons that keeps its beauty for a year or more, with no water needed.
fields.information:
Collection: dried flowers.

What's in it: naturally dried pampas grass, lagurus (bunny tails), golden craspedia (billy buttons), preserved eucalyptus, dried statice, phalaris and ruscus, in cream, beige, wheat and soft caramel tones. Some stems are bleached or tinted with plant-based dyes to achieve the neutral palette. The bouquet is about 50 cm tall and 30 cm wide, wrapped in cream paper with a linen ribbon.

How long it lasts: 1 to 2 years indoors. Dried flowers don't wilt, but their colours fade gradually, faster in direct sunlight. In Singapore's humidity they last longest in an air-conditioned room; avoid bathrooms, kitchens and windowsills.

Care:
- No water, ever: water makes dried flowers go mouldy.
- Keep away from direct sun, humidity and fans blowing directly at it.
- To dust, use a hairdryer on the cool, low setting from about 30 cm away, or a soft makeup brush.
- If the stems get crushed in transport, gently reshape them by hand; pampas fluffs up again after a day out of the wrapping.

Shedding: pampas grass and bunny tails naturally shed a few fibres, especially in the first week. We lightly spray every bouquet with a clear fixative to reduce this, but a little shedding is normal.

Options:
- Colour palettes: Neutral (this one), Blush (pinks and creams) or Sunset (terracotta, rust and mustard), same price.
- A matching matte ceramic vase (18 cm tall, in white or sand) for $25. The bouquet can go straight into the vase as it is.

Allergies, children and pets: dried flowers have far less pollen than fresh ones, but the fine pampas fibres can irritate people with sensitive airways. They're not edible and contain small parts, so keep them out of reach of young children and pets who might chew them.

Shipping: because dried bouquets are light and need no water, they can also be couriered in a gift box. Same-day and scheduled delivery are the same as for our other flowers.

fields.name: Soap Rose Gift Box (9 Roses)
fields.description: Nine velvety soap roses nestled in a round keepsake box: they look just like the real thing, smell softly of rose and never wilt.
fields.information:
Collection: soap flowers.

What it's made of: each petal is a thin, pressed layer of plant-based glycerin soap, dyed and shaped by hand, then assembled into rose heads about 5 cm across and lightly scented with rose fragrance. The roses sit in a round hat box (15 cm across and 12 cm tall) with a lid and a satin ribbon.

Colours: red, pink, champagne, lavender, blue or mixed pastels.

How long it lasts: as a decoration, for years; the soap doesn't wilt or rot. The rose scent fades gradually over about 6 months. Colours stay bright if kept out of the sun.

Can you use them as soap? Yes, the petals are real soap: pull off a petal or two to wash your hands, or float a few in a bath, where they dissolve within a minute. They're thin, so most customers keep them as a decoration.

Care:
- Keep them dry, away from bathrooms, kitchen sinks and humid windowsills; moisture makes the petals soft and sticky.
- Avoid direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
- Dust gently with a soft brush or a hairdryer on the cool setting.

Skin and safety: the soap contains fragrance, so if you have sensitive skin, try a petal on a small patch of skin first. The roses are not edible and the petals are small, so keep them away from young children and pets.

Options:
- Add warm-white fairy lights inside the box for $5.
- A printed ribbon on the lid (for example "Happy Mother's Day" or "Thank You") at no extra cost.
- Corporate and bulk orders: from 30 boxes, $32 each, with your logo on the lid sticker for $1 per box. Please allow 7 working days.

fields.name: Single PT Session (60 min)
fields.description: One-on-one session with a certified coach.
fields.information: 60 minutes with a certified coach at our gym: a short warm-up, the main workout planned for your goals, and a cool-down. Bring a towel and water; shoes are required. Reschedule at least 24 hours ahead or the session is forfeited.

fields.name: 10-Session PT Package
fields.description: Ten one-on-one sessions, valid for 3 months.
fields.information: Ten 60-minute one-on-one sessions with the same coach, to be used within 3 months of the first session. Includes a fitness assessment in the first session and a written plan. The package is non-refundable but can be transferred to a friend once.

fields.name: Iced Teh Tarik
fields.description: Our pulled milk tea, served over ice: strong Ceylon and Assam tea with condensed and evaporated milk, pulled until frothy and smooth. One 16 oz cup; the hot version (8 oz) is the same price.
fields.information:
Our pulled milk tea, served over ice. We brew strong black tea from a blend of Ceylon and Assam leaves, sweeten it with condensed milk and evaporated milk, then "pull" it: pour it from a height between two jugs until it's frothy and smooth.

Size: 16 oz (470 ml) cup with ice. The hot version (8 oz) is the same price.

Sweetness: it's on the sweet side by default; ask for siew dai (less sweet). We can't make it with no sugar, because the condensed milk is part of the recipe.

Allergens: contains dairy (condensed and evaporated milk). It has caffeine from the tea, about half a cup of coffee's worth.

fields.name: Pandan Chiffon Cake (Whole)
fields.description: A whole pandan chiffon cake (20 cm, about 8 to 10 slices), light and springy, baked fresh every morning with real pandan juice and no artificial colouring. Please order at least one day ahead.
fields.information:
A whole pandan chiffon cake, light and springy, baked fresh every morning in a 20 cm tube pan (about 8 to 10 slices).

We blend fresh pandan leaves into juice for the flavour and natural green colour, with no artificial colouring or flavouring. The batter is made with eggs, sugar, cake flour, coconut milk and vegetable oil, and lifted with whipped egg whites instead of butter, so it's dairy-free.

Allergens: contains eggs, wheat (gluten) and coconut. Made in a kitchen that also handles dairy, peanuts and sesame.

Ordering: we bake a limited number each day, so please order at least one day ahead for a specific pickup time. It comes in a cake box.

Storage: keep it covered at room temperature and eat it within 2 days, or refrigerate for up to 4 days. Don't freeze it, as the texture suffers.

fields.name: Sunflower Hand-Tied Bouquet
fields.description: Three sunny sunflowers with chamomile daisies and soft greens: a bright, cheerful pick-me-up for graduations, birthdays and get-well wishes.
fields.information:
Collection: fresh flowers.

What's in it: 3 sunflower stems (heads 10 to 12 cm across), white chamomile daisies, yellow solidago and ruscus leaves, hand-tied and wrapped in kraft paper with jute twine. The bouquet is about 45 cm tall and 30 cm wide.

Pollen: we use a pollen-free sunflower variety ('Sunrich'), so the flowers won't drop yellow dust on clothes or tablecloths, and they're kinder to people with hay fever. The chamomile does have a little pollen.

How long it lasts: 5 to 7 days with proper care. Sunflowers are thirsty flowers, so top up the water every day; the daisies usually last a day or two longer than the sunflowers. Our sunflowers come from farms in the Netherlands and Malaysia and are available all year round.

Care: trim 2 to 3 cm off the stems at an angle, remove any leaves that would sit below the water line, and use a tall, heavy vase, because sunflower heads are top-heavy. Sunflowers naturally turn towards light, so rotate the vase every day or two to keep the heads straight. Keep away from direct afternoon sun and aircon vents.

Options:
- Upgrade to 5 sunflowers for $78.
- Graduation add-on: a 15 cm plush bear in a graduation cap and gown for $15.
- Get-well add-on: a small fruit basket (apples, oranges, grapes) for $35.

Graduation season: from May to July (and in December), sunflowers are in very high demand for school and university graduations. Please order at least 3 days ahead in these months; we can also deliver to a convocation venue's drop-off point if you give us the date, hall and a contact number.

Pets: sunflowers are non-toxic to cats and dogs, but chamomile can upset their stomachs if eaten. Let us know if you have pets and we'll swap the chamomile for more greenery.

Hospitals: some hospital wards in Singapore don't allow fresh flowers (especially ICU and oncology wards). Please check with the ward first, or consider our Crochet Sunflower Bouquet, which needs no water and has no pollen.

fields.name: Grand Opening Flower Stand (2-Tier)
fields.description: A show-stopping 1.6 m congratulatory stand bursting with orchids, gerberas and sunflowers, made to make a new shop, clinic or office opening impossible to miss.
fields.information:
Collection: fresh flowers (congratulatory stands).

What's in it: two large floral arrangements set in floral foam on a foldable black metal stand, about 1.6 m tall and 70 cm wide. The flowers are Mokara orchids, gerberas, sunflowers, spray roses and chrysanthemums with palm and monstera leaves. Each stand includes a two-sided ribbon sash printed with your congratulatory message (for example "Congratulations on your Grand Opening") on one side and the sender's name or company on the other, up to 40 characters per side.

Colour themes:
- Red and gold (default): traditionally associated with prosperity and good fortune, popular for Chinese-owned businesses.
- Pastel pink and white: popular for clinics, salons and cafés.
- Blue and white: a cleaner corporate look for offices and law firms.

How long it lasts: 5 to 7 days indoors in an air-conditioned space, or 3 to 4 days outdoors in Singapore's heat. The recipient can mist the flowers with water once a day to keep them fresh; the foam can be topped up with a little water from the top.

Ordering and delivery:
- Please order at least 2 working days ahead, so we can print the ribbon and source the orchids. We make up to 4 stands a day.
- Delivery is free anywhere in mainland Singapore, in a 9am to 12pm or 2pm to 6pm window. A 1-hour window (for example, before an opening ceremony) costs $30 more.
- The stand is delivered fully assembled and placed where the recipient wants it, usually at the shop entrance. If the location is in a shopping mall, please check whether the mall requires a loading bay booking.
- We collect the empty metal stand 7 days after delivery, free of charge. Just message us if it should be collected earlier or later.

Upgrade: a 3-tier stand (about 1.9 m) is $428.

Please note: this stand is for celebrations only. For condolences we make separate funeral wreaths in white and soft tones, which aren't listed here; message us and our team will help.

fields.name: Mini Dried Flower Posy
fields.description: A palm-sized posy of dried lavender, baby's breath and bunny tails: a sweet little thank-you, a desk pick-me-up or a charming wedding favour.
fields.information:
Collection: dried flowers.

What's in it: dried French lavender, baby's breath and lagurus (bunny tails), with a sprig of preserved eucalyptus. The posy is about 20 cm tall and 10 cm across, wrapped in translucent glassine paper and tied with cotton twine and a small kraft tag (you can write on it, or ask us to).

Scent: the lavender keeps a light, relaxing scent for about 3 months. To refresh it, gently squeeze the lavender buds.

How long it lasts: a year or more indoors, kept dry and out of direct sun. Lavender buds may drop a little over time; that's normal for dried lavender.

Colours: purple and white (default), or pink and white (pink-tinted baby's breath and statice instead of lavender, no lavender scent).

Bulk orders (wedding favours, baby showers, corporate gifts):
- From 20 posies: $22 each.
- Custom printed tags (for example, the couple's names and wedding date) for $0.80 per posy.
- Please allow 2 weeks for bulk orders, and confirm the final number at least 7 days before the event.

Display: it fits a small bud vase or jar. We sell a clear glass bud vase (10 cm) for $12.

Pets: lavender is mildly toxic to cats and dogs, so place it out of their reach.

fields.name: Preserved Rose Bell Jar
fields.description: A single preserved red rose under a glass dome, glowing with warm fairy lights: a fairy-tale keepsake that stays perfect for years.
fields.information:
Collection: preserved flowers.

What it is: a real rose, grown in Ecuador and preserved at its peak bloom: the natural sap is replaced with a plant-based glycerin solution and dye, so the petals stay soft and look freshly cut, without water. The rose head is about 6 to 7 cm across.

The display: a glass dome 22 cm tall and 12 cm wide, on a natural wooden base, with a string of warm-white LED fairy lights inside. The lights run on 2 AA batteries (included), with a switch hidden under the base; a fresh pair lasts about 30 hours of lighting. It comes in a black gift box with a ribbon and a carrier bag.

How long it lasts: 3 to 5 years, if kept indoors away from direct sunlight and humidity. The colour can soften slightly over time.

Care:
- Keep the dome closed as much as possible; it protects the rose from dust and humidity.
- Don't touch or press the petals, and never water the rose or put it in the fridge.
- Don't place it in direct sunlight or next to a window, which fades the colour.
- To clean, wipe the outside of the glass with a soft, dry cloth.

Options:
- Colours: red (default), pink, white or lavender, subject to stock.
- Engraving: a brass plate on the base with up to 20 characters (for example a name and date) for $15. Please allow 3 working days.

Availability: our preserved roses are imported in small batches, so stock is limited and often runs out around Valentine's Day, anniversaries season and Christmas. When it's sold out, message us and we'll let you know as soon as the next batch arrives (usually within 2 to 3 weeks).

Allergies: preserved roses have no pollen and no scent.

fields.name: Soap Carnation Bouquet
fields.description: A sweet bouquet of seven pink soap carnations with baby's breath: the classic way to say thank you to Mum or a favourite teacher, made to last.
fields.information:
Collection: soap flowers.

What's in it: 7 soap carnations (heads about 6 cm across) with ruffled, hand-dyed soap petals, natural dried baby's breath and faux eucalyptus leaves, wrapped Korean-style in two layers of paper with a ribbon. The bouquet is about 35 cm tall. The carnation stems and leaves are artificial (fabric over wire), so they stay upright and green.

Colours: pink (default), red, or mixed pastels (pink, peach and cream).

How long it lasts: as a decoration, indefinitely. The light carnation scent lasts about 4 to 6 months. The dried baby's breath is natural, so it may shed a little.

Care: keep dry and out of direct sun. It can be displayed in a dry vase (no water) or left in its wrapping. Like all our soap flowers, the petals can be used as soap: one or two petals for a hand-wash.

Mother's Day and Teachers' Day: carnations are the traditional Mother's Day flower, and this bouquet is our best-seller for Mother's Day (the second Sunday of May) and Teachers' Day (the Friday before 1 September). In those weeks, please order at least 7 days ahead: delivery slots fill up quickly, and we stop taking orders for the day itself once we reach capacity.

Options:
- Add a soap-flower-scented mini candle for $9.
- Upgrade to 12 carnations for $62.

Skin and safety: the soap contains fragrance; do a patch test if you have sensitive skin. Not edible; keep away from young children and pets. Baby's breath is mildly toxic to cats and dogs.

fields.name: Single Soap Rose Stem
fields.description: One long-stemmed soap rose in a clear sleeve with a ribbon: an affordable little gesture for classmates, colleagues or event giveaways.
fields.information:
Collection: soap flowers.

What it is: a single soap rose (head about 6 cm across) on a 40 cm artificial stem with leaves, individually wrapped in a clear cellophane sleeve with a satin ribbon and a small blank tag for a message.

Colours: red, pink, white, blue or purple. Mixed colours are fine for bulk orders.

How long it lasts: years as a decoration; the scent fades over about 6 months. Keep dry and out of direct sunlight. The petals can be used as soap.

Bulk pricing (great for Teachers' Day, Valentine's Day at school, graduations, company Women's Day and event giveaways):
- 1 to 49 stems: $5.90 each.
- 50 to 99 stems: $4.90 each.
- 100 stems or more: $4.50 each.
- Custom printed tags (your message or logo) for $0.50 per stem.
- Bulk orders need 5 working days.

Delivery: the usual delivery fee applies, so for one or two stems, self-pickup from our Joo Chiat studio (free) is usually the better option.

Safety: contains fragrance; not edible. The stem has a wire inside, so it isn't a toy for young children.

fields.name: Hand-Crocheted Single Tulip
fields.description: A plump, hand-crocheted tulip on a bendable stem, made stitch by stitch in our studio from soft milk-cotton yarn: a flower that never fades.
fields.information:
Collection: crochet flowers.

Who makes it: every crochet flower is made by hand by our in-house crochet artist, Priya, and a small team of home-based crocheters in Singapore. A tulip takes about 1.5 hours to make, so no two are exactly alike.

What it's made of: 5-ply milk cotton yarn (a soft cotton and acrylic blend, with no wool), stuffed with polyester fibrefill, on a 2 mm wire stem wrapped in green yarn, with two crochet leaves. The stem bends, so you can shape it in a vase. The tulip is about 30 cm tall, with a flower head about 5 cm tall.

Colours: red, pink, yellow, white, lilac or orange. A custom colour from our yarn chart takes 3 working days more.

How long it lasts: forever, really. The colours stay bright indoors for years; long direct sunlight can fade them slowly.

Care:
- Dust it gently with a lint roller or a soft brush.
- To clean, spot-clean with a damp cloth and a drop of mild soap, then let it air-dry. Don't machine-wash or soak it: the wire stem can rust.
- Keep away from pets that like to chew, because of the wire inside.

Not a toy: because of the wire stem, it's not suitable for children under 3.

Wrapping: each tulip comes in a clear sleeve with a ribbon. Order 3 or more to make a bouquet: we'll wrap them together in paper for $5.

Allergies: no pollen, no scent, and no wool, which makes crochet flowers a good choice for allergy sufferers and hospital visits.

fields.name: Crochet Sunflower Bouquet (3 Stems)
fields.description: Three hand-crocheted sunflowers with crochet leaves and baby's breath: all the sunshine of a real bouquet, without ever needing water.
fields.information:
Collection: crochet flowers.

What's in it: 3 hand-crocheted sunflowers, each about 9 cm across, with 16 golden petals and a textured brown centre made of bobble stitches, on wire stems with crochet leaves. They're arranged with natural dried baby's breath and wrapped in kraft paper with a linen ribbon. The bouquet is about 40 cm tall. Each sunflower takes our crocheters about 4 hours.

What it's made of: milk cotton yarn (cotton and acrylic, no wool) with polyester fibrefill and wire stems. The baby's breath is real dried flowers, so it can shed a little; for a completely shed-free bouquet, ask for crochet baby's breath instead, for $8 more.

How long it lasts: for years. It needs no water and doesn't wilt; colours stay bright indoors out of direct sunlight.

Care: dust gently with a soft brush or lint roller; spot-clean with a damp cloth and air-dry. Don't wash or soak it (wire stems). Keep away from pets and young children (wire).

Availability: we keep a small number ready-made. When those run out, each bouquet is made to order and takes 5 to 7 working days.

Options:
- Graduation add-on: a mini crochet graduation cap (with a tassel in your school's colour) for $9.
- Upgrade to 5 sunflowers for $92.

Great for: graduations, hospital visits (no pollen, no water, so it's allowed in most wards), and anyone who wants a bouquet that will still look the same next year.

fields.name: Crochet Forever Rose Bouquet (12 Stems)
fields.description: Twelve hand-crocheted red roses with layered, gently curled petals, wrapped in luxe black paper: our most-loved anniversary gift, made to stay beautiful.
fields.information:
Collection: crochet flowers.

What's in it: 12 hand-crocheted roses (heads about 6 cm across), each with layered, curled petals and a green calyx, on wire stems with crochet leaves, arranged with crochet baby's breath (so nothing sheds). The bouquet is about 50 cm tall and 30 cm wide, wrapped in black Korean paper with a satin ribbon, and comes with a carrier bag.

The work behind it: each rose takes about 3 hours, so a bouquet is roughly 36 hours of handwork by our crocheters. That's why we make a limited batch each month, and why it often sells out around Valentine's Day and anniversaries.

What it's made of: milk cotton yarn (cotton and acrylic, no wool) in deep red, with polyester fibrefill and wire stems.

How long it lasts: forever. It needs no water, won't wilt and holds its shape for years. Keep it out of long direct sunlight so the red stays rich.

Care: dust gently with a soft brush or lint roller, and spot-clean with a damp cloth if needed; never wash or soak it (wire stems). Keep away from pets and young children (wire).

Options:
- Colours: red (default), pink, white, burgundy or mixed, made to order.
- Wrapping in white paper instead of black, at no extra cost.
- Warm-white fairy lights woven into the bouquet for $5.

Made to order: when the ready-made batch is sold out, a bouquet can be made to order in 10 to 14 working days. For a specific date (such as a proposal or anniversary), please order at least 3 weeks ahead.

Allergies: no pollen, no scent and no wool.
